rv.q: More a muddle than a triumph, it may prove a confusing introduction to Shakespeare; but it’s a visually memorable one nonetheless.
Lend your ears to Julius Caesar Remixed, a worthy 90 minutes of inspiring, entertaining and relevant theatre.
Julius Caesar Remixed powerfully reimagines Shakespeare, resulting in an astounding symphony of vibrancy and sensitivity.

cn.t: Critics are split on these Shakespeare remixes: one urban reimagining earns strong praise for its electric ensemble and punchy modernity, while an all-female revival draws admiration for performances but feels its concept has lost its original impact.
